title: Release
summary: A record, a single, an episode: the cover art rises in, who and what, a pulse on the track's beat, the date and where to listen, in 15 s.

params.name: title
params.description: the record, the single, the episode

params.name: artist
params.description: who; empty uses the brand's name

params.name: what
params.description: what this is, in plain words

params.name: action
params.description: the date and where to listen

params.name: bpm
params.description: the track's tempo: the cover and the bars move on it

params.name: cover
params.description: the square cover art (path); empty fills the sleeve with the brand's shader

params.name: background
params.description: a background id from the registry; empty uses the brand's first

usage:
npx paper-motion add release --name my-piece
# put the cover in, edit CONFIG in pieces/my-piece/scene.html, then:
npx paper-motion render pieces/my-piece/scene.html --audio track.wav --loudness -14
notes: Wired to the brand folder: needs brand/tokens.json (a palette and a font pair work: pamo add sage-night instrument) and, for the background, a shader-set entry (pamo add mesh-sage).
Made for a cover and a track: render with --audio; the pulse follows CONFIG.bpm, not the audio.
Uses these moves from the engine: word-rise, track-in, blur-in.
when: a record, a single or an episode comes out
you have cover art and the track

beats.name: Cover
beats.what: the sleeve rises through a mask

beats.name: Pulse
beats.what: the cover and a row of bars move on the beat

beats.name: Action
beats.what: the date and where to listen, then the wordmark
